deploy.startCommand: cd packages/db && npx prisma migrate deploy || { echo '=== prisma migrate deploy failed (P3009 class) ==='; echo 'Do not restart until the failed migration is resolved. From a running container that ships packages/db (railway ssh --service frontend):'; echo '  1. npx prisma migrate resolve --rolled-back "<failed-migration-name>"'; echo '  2. npx prisma db execute --stdin   # the migration SQL minus the statement that failed'; echo '  3. npx prisma migrate resolve --applied "<failed-migration-name>"'; echo '  4. railway redeploy --service backend'; echo 'Full procedure: docs/wiki/config/database-setup.md#failed-migration-recovery'; exit 1; }; cd ../../backend && node src/api/server.js
